title: Selective TT-Read Subpath Intervention, Main/Successor/QSearch Factorial Decomposition, Interaction-Specific Exact-Value Causality & Cross-Version Mechanism Localization

fresh_world.freshness_rule: P15-only five-piece material families absent from P13 and P14 generator families; generation-index offset 20000

instrument.base: P12 RC1 semantics preserved; P15 adds site-selective masking only
instrument.full_mask_equivalence_requirement: MASK_ALL must reproduce P12 MASKED semantics under the same target/runtime

tranche.selection: round-robin across material_signature x side_to_move; within stratum descending minimum-across-target per-site semantic-use floor, then tau4, then candidate_sha256

estimands.factorial_decomposition: Mobius contrasts of arm-level mean change indicators over the 2^3 intervention cube

localization_grammar.single_subpath_localization: same singleton site yields >=2 fine-value-change cells on both engine targets and its changed-cell set overlaps at least half of MASK_ALL fine-value witnesses on each target
localization_grammar.interaction_localization: no singleton qualifies, but the same pair/triple has positive Mobius fine-change contrast >=0.08 on both targets and combination fine-change rate >=0.10 on both targets
localization_grammar.distributed_nonlocal: fresh selective effects occur but neither cross-version singleton nor interaction localization gate is met
localization_grammar.no_selective_effect: no selective arm changes action or fine exact value on the committed tranche

forbidden_inferences: a surviving localization rival is proven true merely because alternatives fail
